يمتثلوا (form VIII)
# يَمْتَثِلُوا (yamtaṯilū) /jam.ta.θi.luː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِمْتَثَلَ (imtaṯala)
# يُمْتَثَلُوا (yumtaṯalū) /jum.ta.θa.luː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِمْتَثَلَ (imtaṯala)
